plays.name: Punt — Base

players.label: S
players.job: Snap it back to the punter, then get your head up. You are the middle of the coverage, so run straight down the field at the returner.

players.label: RGD
players.job: Hold your gap. Nobody comes through you. After the kick, get downfield and take the middle of the field.

players.label: LGD
players.job: Protection comes first. Punch the rusher inside and keep him off the punter. When the ball is away, release and fill the middle.

players.label: RT
players.job: Block first, then go. Once the ball is gone you are coverage. Keep outside leverage and turn the returner into your help.

players.label: LT
players.job: Block the man over you for two counts so the punter is safe, then release and cover. Stay outside the returner and squeeze him back inside.

players.label: RG
players.job: Same as the other gunner. Get off the line, get downfield fast, and be the first man to the returner. Do not run past the ball.

players.label: LG
players.job: You are the first one down there. Release outside, beat the man trying to hold you up, and get to the returner before he starts upfield. Stay in your lane.

players.label: RW
players.job: Seal the edge, then cover. Once you release, stay wide. If he gets outside you there is nobody behind you.

players.label: LW
players.job: You are the edge of the wall. Nobody gets around you to the punter. Block first, then release outside and keep the returner in front of you.

players.label: PP
players.job: You are the last man before the punter. Check the count, call the protection, and block anybody who comes free. Then get downfield.

players.label: P
players.job: Catch it, two steps, get it off. After the kick you are the safety, so stay behind the ball and be ready to make the tackle.

plays.howItWorks: Spread punt. Wide splits force them to spread out too, which cuts down the rush angles at the punter. Everybody blocks first and covers second — the ball is gone in about two seconds, so protection is short and then all eleven are in coverage lanes. The gunners are the only two who release straight away; their landmark is three yards outside the returner so he cannot get to the sideline.

aim.label: PUNT HERE — OUTSIDE THE NUMBERS, 35 YARDS

plays.name: Punt — Villanova Fake

players.label: S
players.job: Snap it to Archuletta, not the punter. Same snap, same speed, then block down to the fake side with everybody else.

players.label: RGD
players.job: Block down to the fake side, exactly like the base punt for two counts. Everything going that way is what empties the other side for him.

players.label: LGD
players.job: Block down to the fake side, exactly like the base punt for two counts. Everything going that way is what empties the other side for him.

players.label: RT
players.job: Block down to the fake side, exactly like the base punt for two counts. Everything going that way is what empties the other side for him.

players.label: LT
players.job: Block down to the fake side, exactly like the base punt for two counts. Everything going that way is what empties the other side for him.

players.label: RG
players.job: If the ball is coming your way you are his escort: up the sideline, block the first man inside you, stay on your feet. If it is going away, block down with the flow and sell it.

players.label: LG
players.job: If the ball is coming your way you are his escort: up the sideline, block the first man inside you, stay on your feet. If it is going away, block down with the flow and sell it.

players.label: RW
players.job: Same as the other wing — go to the fake side, right behind him. Two men running one way is what makes them bite. Block whoever chases you.

players.label: LW
players.job: Run to the fake side like you have the ball. You and the other wing going the same way is what sells it. The harder they chase you, the emptier the other side gets.

players.label: PP
players.job: The snap comes to you, not the punter. Show it hard to the wings going one way — eyes, shoulders, the whole thing — then pull it out and come out the back door the other side. Your gunner on that side is your escort. Do not turn upfield until you are past the numbers.

players.label: P
players.job: You never touch it. Sell the punt — catch nothing, take your steps and swing your leg. Do not look at Archuletta.

plays.howItWorks: A fake out of the base punt, and it has to look exactly like the punt until the ball is gone. The snap goes to Archuletta at protector. Both wings and the whole line flow one way, Archuletta shows them the ball going that way, and then he comes out the back door the other side and runs the sideline behind his gunner. The punter never touches it. The play is not the run — the play is that eleven of them chase the wrong side of the field. It runs either direction; the chips above the field pick which.

looks.name: Ball left
looks.how: Scott and Dalley both run right and the line blocks right, so everything they can see is going that way. Archuletta shows them the ball going right, pulls it out and comes out the back door to the left, where Pace leads him up the sideline.

aim.label: ARCHULETTA — LEFT SIDELINE BEHIND PACE, TO THE END ZONE

looks.name: Ball right
looks.how: The same play the other way. Scott and Dalley both run left and the line blocks left; Archuletta shows it left, pulls it out and comes out the back door to the right, up the sideline behind Grover.

aim.label: ARCHULETTA — RIGHT SIDELINE BEHIND GROVER, TO THE END ZONE

plays.name: Punt Return — Purple D

players.label: LJ
players.job: Hold their gunner up at the line. Get hands on him, slow him down, keep him from running free. Every second you buy is a yard for the returner.

players.label: L2
players.job: Same as the man next to you. Show rush, get hands on him, do not let him release clean. Once the ball is up, turn and get in front of the return.

players.label: L1
players.job: Line up over the man in front of you and look like you are rushing — that keeps him blocking instead of releasing. Get your hands on him and hold him at the line. Every second he is stuck is a yard for the returner. Then peel to the return side.

players.label: R1
players.job: Show rush, then hold him up. You are not trying to block the punt — you are trying to make him late getting downfield.

players.label: R2
players.job: Hands on, slow him down, then peel. Nobody on this unit actually rushes the punter.

players.label: RJ
players.job: Same on your side. Body him, redirect him, do not let him release clean.

players.label: LM
players.job: Do not rush. Drop and find the first coverage man coming down your side. Take him on the side the return is going and stay on your feet.

players.label: RM
players.job: Drop back and read where the ball is going. Pick up the first man in your area and turn him away from the returner.

players.label: LB
players.job: Once the ball is in the air, peel to the return side and set the wall down the sideline — a few yards apart from the man beside you. Bring the wall to the ball. Block the man on your outside shoulder.

players.label: RB
players.job: Get to the return side and build the wall. Face the coverage, not the ball. Your man is whoever shows up on your outside shoulder.

players.label: PR
players.job: Catch it first, then run. Call for the fair catch if they are on top of you. Get north and south — do not run sideways.

plays.howItWorks: Six up front to make them think we are rushing, which keeps their linemen blocking instead of releasing. The two jammers hold their gunners up at the line. Nobody actually rushes the punter; once the ball is up, the front peels to the return side and the wall sets down the sideline. Catch it clean first, then run.

aim.label: RETURN HERE — UP BEHIND THE WALL

plays.name: Punt Return — White D

players.label: LJ
players.job: Hold their gunner up at the line so he cannot get down the field clean.

players.label: L2
players.job: Show rush, then hold up. The longer he is stuck, the longer our returner has.

players.label: L1
players.job: Look like you are rushing, then get hands on him and hold him at the line so he cannot get downfield clean.

players.label: R1
players.job: Hands on him at the snap. Slow him down, then peel to the return side.

players.label: R2
players.job: Same on your side. Do not let him release free.

players.label: RJ
players.job: Get hands on him and slow him down. Buy the returner time.

players.label: LM
players.job: Drop, do not rush. Find the first coverage man on your side and block him away from the return.

players.label: RM
players.job: Read where the ball is going, then take the first man who shows up in your area.

players.label: LB
players.job: Peel to the return side once the ball is up and set the wall down the sideline. Bring the wall to the ball.

players.label: RB
players.job: Build the wall with the man beside you. Face the coverage. Block whoever comes to your outside shoulder.

players.label: PR
players.job: Catch it first. Only then think about running. Fair catch is always the right call if they are already there.

plays.howItWorks: Same shape and same rules as Purple, second unit. Six up front, two jammers on their gunners, wall to the return side once the ball is in the air. Fair catch is always the right call if coverage is already there.

aim.label: RETURN HERE — UP BEHIND THE WALL

plays.name: Kickoff — Spread

players.label: R5
players.job: Run straight at the ball. Stay in your lane, keep your shoulders square, and make the tackle. Do not run around blocks — run through your lane.

players.label: R4
players.job: Nothing gets outside you. Stay wider than the returner the whole way. If he breaks out, that is on you. Squeeze him back to the middle.

players.label: R3
players.job: Beat your blocker and turn the returner inside. You are the one who makes him choose, so get there fast and get skinny.

players.label: R2
players.job: Fill the gap between contain and the ball. Stay a step behind the front so you can see it, then close on whichever side he picks.

players.label: R1
players.job: Run straight at the ball. Stay in your lane, keep your shoulders square, and make the tackle. Do not run around blocks — run through your lane.

players.label: L1
players.job: Run straight at the ball. Stay in your lane, keep your shoulders square, and make the tackle. Do not run around blocks — run through your lane.

players.label: L2

players.label: L3

players.label: L4

players.label: L5
players.job: Run straight at the ball. Stay in your lane, keep your shoulders square, and make the tackle. Do not run around blocks — run through your lane.

players.label: K
players.job: You are the last man. Stay behind everyone, never pass the ball, and make the tackle if he gets through. If you miss, he scores.

plays.howItWorks: Ten across, level with the kicker, so the whole unit times its run-up together and crosses the free kick line at full speed at the same moment. Every man has a lane and stays in it — coverage breaks down when someone runs around a block instead of through his lane. The kicker is the safety and stays behind the ball the whole way.

looks.name: Deep
looks.how: The kick we want: high, to the corner, landing inside their 10. Everybody sprints his lane and keeps his shoulders square. Nobody passes the BALL men.

aim.label: KICK HERE — DEEP CORNER, INSIDE THE 10

looks.name: Pooch
looks.how: High and short, about 25 yards, dropped in front of their deep men so one of their blockers has to catch it. Less field to cover: the whole line squeezes toward the ball and the outside men tighten instead of running past it.

aim.label: POOCH — HIGH AND SHORT, IN FRONT OF THEIR DEEP MEN

looks.name: Squib
looks.how: Low and hard along the ground so their front line has to field it, not their returner. It is a live ball: the middle five attack it, the outside men hold their lanes in case it is picked up and brought back.

aim.label: SQUIB — LOW AND HARD, ON THE GROUND BY THEIR 35

plays.name: Kickoff — Cluster Speed
plays.lineLabel: FREE KICK LINE — INSIDE THE NUMBERS

players.label: H5
players.job: Stay in the huddle until the kicker starts his approach. The second he moves, you go — break to your lane on the right and stay in it. You are one of the wide men, so you have the furthest to run and nobody gets outside you.

players.label: H4
players.job: Stay in the huddle until the kicker starts his approach. The second he moves, you go — break to your lane on the right and stay in it. Run through your lane at the ball, not around blocks.

players.label: H3
players.job: Stay in the huddle until the kicker starts his approach. The second he moves, you go — break to your lane on the left and stay in it. Run through your lane at the ball, not around blocks.

players.label: H10
players.job: Stay in the huddle until the kicker starts his approach. The second he moves, you go — break to your lane on the left and stay in it. Run through your lane at the ball, not around blocks.

players.label: K
players.job: You are the last man. Stay behind the ball the whole way, never pass it, and make the tackle if he breaks through.

plays.howItWorks: The ten huddle inside the numbers instead of spreading out. They hold until the kicker starts his approach, then break to their lanes. It makes the return team guess, and it forces them to compress in case of an onside, which takes blockers away from the return. Fast kids on this one — they have further to travel to the outside lanes.

looks.name: Deep
looks.how: The pairs break for the sidelines as the kicker starts his approach, and the kick goes deep to a corner away from their best returner. The huddle makes them stay home in case it is onside, so the field is wider than it looks.

aim.label: KICK HERE — DEEP CORNER, AWAY FROM THEIR BEST RETURNER

looks.name: Pooch
looks.how: Same break, shorter kick. The pairs still get to the sidelines but stop their sprint at the ball instead of running past it, and the middle lanes come up hard under the catch.

aim.label: POOCH — HIGH AND SHORT, IN FRONT OF THEIR DEEP MEN

looks.name: Squib
looks.how: The one to call if they have a returner we cannot tackle. It goes on the ground at their front line while our pairs are already moving, so we are on top of it before they have it clean.

aim.label: SQUIB — LOW AND HARD, ON THE GROUND BY THEIR 35

plays.howItWorks: Same huddle and same break as Cluster Speed, run with the boys who need snaps. The X-men stay interior, which is where the league requires them and also the shortest run. The huddle does the work here — it buys the coverage a half second because the return team cannot see who is going where until the kicker moves.

looks.name: Deep
looks.how: Deep and down the middle, because the middle is the easiest place for a young unit to fit. Everybody has a lane and nobody has to make a decision on the run.

aim.label: KICK HERE — DEEP AND DOWN THE MIDDLE

looks.name: Pooch
looks.how: High and short so it lands on one of their blockers instead of their returner. Short field, so nobody outruns the ball — get to it and get square.

aim.label: POOCH — HIGH AND SHORT, IN FRONT OF THEIR DEEP MEN

looks.name: Squib
looks.how: On the ground at their front line. It is a live ball and it is the play most likely to give this group a takeaway, so everybody runs to the football.

aim.label: SQUIB — LOW AND HARD, ON THE GROUND BY THEIR 35

plays.name: Kickoff — Onside

players.label: R4
players.job: Widest man away from the kick. If they get it and try to bring it back this way, you are the edge.

players.label: R3
players.job: Cover your lane. Stay in it even though the ball is on the far side.

players.label: R2
players.job: Get downfield fast. If they recover it, you are the one who stops the return.

players.label: R1
players.job: The kick is going the other way. Sprint down and cover in case they come up with it — you are the tackler, not the recoverer.

players.label: K
players.job: Drive it into the ground so it takes two big bounces. No pop-ups, they are illegal. Get it past ten yards and give our guys a chance at it.

players.label: L1
players.job: This one is coming to you. It has to travel ten yards before we can touch it, so time your run and arrive as it crosses. Take it in the air if you can. If you cannot, fall on it and cover up.

players.label: L2
players.job: Same as the man beside you. Do not touch it early or we lose it. Get there as it crosses ten, and win the ball.

players.label: L3
players.job: Third man at the ball. If the first two miss it, it is yours. Fall on it — do not try to pick it up and run.

players.label: L4
players.job: You are not recovering it. Get in the way of the first man trying to reach it so our guys can.

players.label: L5
players.job: Block the man closest to where the ball is going. Buy our recover men one extra step.

players.label: L6
players.job: Widest man on the kick side. Nobody gets around you to the ball.

plays.howItWorks: A driven kick that takes two big bounces — pop-ups are illegal, so it has to hit the ground and come up. The ball has to travel ten yards before we can touch it, so the three recover men time their run to arrive exactly as it crosses. Three at the ball, three shielding them, and the four on the away side sprint to cover in case they come up with it.

aim.label: KICK HERE — 11 YARDS, SECOND BOUNCE HEAD HIGH

plays.name: Kick Return — 5-2-2-2

players.label: H5
players.job: Short kick is yours. Do not back up into your own returner.

players.label: H4
players.job: Same as the others. Hands up, eyes on the ball, and if it clears you go find someone to block.

players.label: H3
players.job: You are in the middle. Short kick is yours. If it is deep, turn and block.

players.label: H2
players.job: Front line. Watch for the short kick, and if it goes over you turn and get on the man in front of you.

players.label: H1
players.job: If the ball comes short and low, it is yours. Catch it, do not let it bounce, and get to the sideline.

players.label: RM
players.job: Same on your side. First man in your area is yours. Block him toward the sideline the return is going away from.

players.label: LM
players.job: Do not chase the ball. Take the first coverage man who shows up in your area and turn him away from the return. Get your head across and stay on your feet — a man on the ground blocks nobody.

players.label: RB
players.job: Take the first man down your side. Do not run at the ball — run at the man who is running at the ball.

players.label: LB
players.job: You are the inside of the wall. Find the first man coming down the middle and wall him off. Face the coverage, not the ball.

players.label: RR
players.job: If it is yours, catch it and go. If it is his, get in front of him and block the first man you see.

players.label: LR
players.job: Catch it clean, then pick a side and go. One cut, then straight. Do not dance.

plays.howItWorks: Five across the front doubling as the hands team — anything short is theirs to catch. Behind them two pairs and then the deep two. The returner catches it clean, makes one cut, and gets north. The blockers do not chase the ball; they take the first coverage man in their area and turn him away from the return.

aim.label: RETURN HERE — UP THE SIDELINE BEHIND THE WALL

plays.name: Kick Return — 5-4-2

players.label: H1
players.job: Front line. Short kick is yours to catch.

players.label: H2
players.job: Hands up. If it clears you, turn and block.

players.label: H3
players.job: Middle of the front. Catch anything short, block anything deep.

players.label: H4
players.job: Short kick is yours. Eyes on the ball the whole way.

players.label: H5
players.job: Same job. Do not turn your back on the ball.

players.label: LB
players.job: You are the inside of the wall. Find the first man coming down the middle and wall him off. Face the coverage, not the ball.

players.label: LM
players.job: Do not chase the ball. Take the first coverage man who shows up in your area and turn him away from the return. Get your head across and stay on your feet — a man on the ground blocks nobody.

players.label: RM
players.job: Same on your side. First man in your area is yours. Block him toward the sideline the return is going away from.

players.label: RB
players.job: Take the first man down your side. Do not run at the ball — run at the man who is running at the ball.

players.label: LR
players.job: Catch it, one cut, get north. Trust the wall.

players.label: RR
players.job: Yours or his — either catch it or lead him. Do not both go for it.

plays.howItWorks: Same hands team and same deep pair as the 5-2-2-2, but the four blockers align on one row instead of splitting into pairs. It gets four bodies across the middle sooner, which is better against a team that covers hard down the middle, and gives up a little depth in return.

aim.label: RETURN HERE — STRAIGHT UP THE MIDDLE BEHIND THE FOUR

plays.name: Offense — Base
plays.howItWorks: Base run to the right off the right guard. The line steps playside together and works up to the linebackers, the tight end seals the end inside, and the fullback leads through the first daylight. The back presses the line before he cuts so the hole has time to open. Both receivers release and block the corner — a run breaks for real yards only when somebody outside blocks somebody.

aim.label: RUN HERE — OFF THE RIGHT GUARD’S HIP

players.label: X
players.job: Release like it is a pass, then find the corner and get between him and the ball. Do not cut him — run your feet and stay in front.

players.label: LT
players.job: Step to the man on your inside shoulder and cut off anything crossing behind the play. Nobody chases this from the back side.

players.label: LG
players.job: Step right with the centre, hit the man on him together, then one of you comes off to the linebacker. First one who feels the down man give comes off.

players.label: C
players.job: Snap it and step right at the same time. Get your head across the man playside and work the double with the guard.

players.label: RG
players.job: This is your hole. Step to the man over you, get your head across his playside shoulder and drive him off the ball. Do not go around him.

players.label: RT
players.job: Step with the guard and take the man on your outside shoulder. Keep your feet moving and stay square — you are the outside wall of the hole.

players.label: Y
players.job: Down block on the end. Head inside, hips around, and turn him away from the hole. If nobody is there, climb to the linebacker.

players.label: Z
players.job: Release outside, find the corner and wall him off from the ball. Yours is the block that turns eight yards into a touchdown.

players.label: QB
players.job: Open right, put the ball in his belly deep, then carry out the fake away from the play. Sell it — the backside end is watching you, not him.

players.label: F
players.job: Take the first daylight past the guard and run through the first defender who shows in it. You are looking for the linebacker.

players.label: H
players.job: Take it deep, press the line so the hole has time to open, then cut off the fullback and get north. One cut and go — do not dance.

plays.name: Defense — Purple
plays.howItWorks: The starting eleven in a 4-3. The four down linemen take their gap first and worry about the ball second; the three linebackers read the back and fill the gap the line does not have. Corners have the men outside them, the safeties play over the top and clean up anything that gets past the front seven. Nobody leaves his gap to chase — that is how a run that should be three yards becomes forty.

aim.label: MAKE IT HAPPEN HERE — AT THE LINE, NOT DOWNFIELD

players.label: LDE
players.job: You have the outside. Nothing gets around you — squeeze everything back inside to the help. If the ball goes away, chase from behind, never across.

players.label: LDT
players.job: Take the gap on your side of the centre and get in it hard. Beat the block with your hands, not by running around it.

players.label: RDT
players.job: Same as the other tackle on your side. Get skinny, get through, and make the back go somewhere he did not plan.

players.label: RDE
players.job: Outside is yours. If the tight end tries to turn you in, fight back out. Keep the ball inside you.

players.label: WILL
players.job: Read the back. When he goes away from you, do not run at him — take the cutback lane and wait. Most long runs come back to where you left.

players.label: MIKE
players.job: Read the back and fill the first hole that opens. Downhill, square, and take on the blocker with your inside shoulder so the ball has to go outside.

players.label: SAM
players.job: Read the tight end. If he blocks down, you have the outside behind the end. If he releases, you go with him.

players.label: LCB
players.job: You have the man out there. On a run, come up outside him and turn the ball back inside — never let him get around your outside shoulder.

players.label: RCB
players.job: Same on your side. Cover first, then run support outside-in once you know it is a run.

players.label: SS
players.job: Fit in the alley between the corner and the linebackers. You are the extra man against the run and the help over the top against a pass.

players.label: FS
players.job: You are the last one. Nothing gets behind you. Stay deeper than the deepest until you know where it is going, then come and get it.

glossary.text: — the strip of field you are responsible for. Stay in it. Eleven men in eleven lanes means there is nowhere for the returner to go.
— go straight at the ball carrier through your lane.
— stay wider than the ball carrier so he can never get outside you.
— beat your blocker and turn the ball carrier back inside toward help.
— the space between contain and the ball. You fill whichever side he picks.
— the last man back. Never pass the ball. If he beats you, it is a touchdown.
— on punt, the man split out wide whose only job is getting to the returner first.
— getting your hands on their gunner at the line to slow him down.
— the front line on a kick return. If the ball comes short, it is theirs to catch.
— on an onside kick, the men whose job is winning the loose ball. It has to travel ten yards first.
— block the other team away from the ball so our recover men can get to it.
— catches the kick and runs it back. Catching it clean matters more than the return.
— the last blocker in front of the punter. He makes the calls.
— snaps the ball back to the punter, then covers.
— the man on the edge of the punt formation who seals the outside.
— block first, then run downfield and make the tackle.
— keep the rusher off the punter. Nothing matters more until the ball is gone.
— you do not get the ball. Your job is making them think you do.
— 165 lbs or more. On special teams he has to line up on the front two lines or the line of scrimmage, and he cannot fake a punt.
